description: Use this when the user wants a floor plan, room layout or apartment plan drawn to scale from room sizes, for example "draw a floor plan: living 5x4 m, kitchen 3x4 m next to it" or "plan of my house in feet". Takes rooms as rectangles (width east-west, length north-south) in metres or feet and inches, placed by x/y or right_of/below/left_of/above another room, plus optional doors and windows by wall and offset, a scale (auto, 1:50, 1:100, 1/4in=1ft) and a page size. Returns each room area, the total area, an interactive plan, and SVG, PDF and CSV downloads. Refuses overlapping rooms and openings past a wall end, naming them. Does not draw curved walls, stairs, furniture or wall thickness, and does not read images or files.

doors.description: Doors, up to 60, e.g. [{"room":"Living","wall":"south","offset":1,"width":0.9}]. Drawn as a gap with a swing arc.

offset.description: Distance from the west end (north/south walls) or the north end (east/west walls) to the opening, e.g. 0.5. Default 0.

part.description: For an L-shaped room: 1 or 2, the part whose wall it is. Default 1.

wall.description: north, south, east or west (or top, bottom, right, left).

width.description: Opening width, e.g. "0.9 m" or 3 (feet). Default: door 0.9 m / 3 ft, window 1.2 m / 4 ft.

north_arrow.description: Draw a north arrow pointing up (default true).

page_size.description: PDF and SVG paper: auto (default: A4 for metres, Letter for feet), a4, a3, letter or tabloid. Orientation is chosen to fit.

rooms.description: Rooms as rectangles, up to 40. A room with no position goes to the right of the previous room. Example: [{"name":"Living","width":5,"length":4},{"name":"Kitchen","width":3,"length":4,"right_of":"Living"}].

above.description: Place this room against the north wall of the named room, e.g. "Garage".

below.description: Place this room against the south wall of the named room, left edges aligned, e.g. "Kitchen".

left_of.description: Place this room against the west wall of the named room, e.g. "Hall".

length.description: North-south size (top to bottom), e.g. 3.5 or "3.5 m", or "11 ft 3 in".

name.description: Room name, up to 40 characters, e.g. "Kitchen". Two entries with the same name make one L-shaped room.

offset.description: With right_of or left_of: shift down (negative = up); with below or above: shift right (negative = left), e.g. "1 m".

right_of.description: Place this room against the east wall of the named room, tops aligned, e.g. "Living room". For an L-shaped room this is its first part.

width.description: East-west size (left to right), e.g. 4.2 or "4.2 m" for metres, or 12'6" / "12 ft 6 in" / "12.5 ft" for feet.

x.description: Left edge from the plan origin, e.g. 0. Give x and y together, or one of right_of, below, left_of, above.

y.description: Top edge from the plan origin (y grows to the south), e.g. 0.

scale.description: auto (default: the largest standard scale that fits one page), a ratio like "1:50" or "1:100", or an architect scale like "1/4in=1ft" or "1/8in=1ft".

title.description: Plan title, e.g. "Ground floor". Up to 80 characters.

units.description: Unit for plain numbers. m (default), cm or mm: a metric plan, sizes like 3.5, "350 cm" or "3500 mm"; ft or in: a feet-and-inches plan, sizes like 12'6", "12 ft 6 in", "12.5 ft" or "150 in". With cm, a plain 90 is 90 cm; with in, a plain 30 is 30 inches.

offset.description: Distance from the west end (north/south walls) or the north end (east/west walls) to the opening, e.g. 0.5. Default 0.

part.description: For an L-shaped room: 1 or 2, the part whose wall it is. Default 1.

wall.description: north, south, east or west (or top, bottom, right, left).

width.description: Opening width, e.g. "0.9 m" or 3 (feet). Default: door 0.9 m / 3 ft, window 1.2 m / 4 ft.
